learning_outcomes.text: General philosophy and approach to be followed in the design of basic equipment of chemical processes.
Synthesis of learned professional concepts and their application in design studies.
Formulating design problems, determining and applying solution methods.
Detailed design of basic equipment, determination of optimum design parameters and execution of cost calculations.
Environment, safety, etc. in the design. Awareness of taking into consideration the concepts.
Development of creativity. Gaining professional self-confidence.
Developing written and verbal communication skills.

syllabus_topics: System structure, information flow structure, design variable selection algorithm
Cost calculations and economic design criteria
